title: Pay Invoice
intro: If you've received an invoice from Jyvenche, you can submit payment securely using the link below.

sections.title: Secure Payment
sections.body: Payments are processed through a secure online payment provider. Receipts are issued automatically.

sections.title: Pay Your Invoice
sections.body: Use the Pay Invoice button to complete payment through your secure link.

sections.title: Important Notes
bullets: This page is intended only for clients with an issued invoice.
If you do not have an invoice link, request one via email.
Payments are subject to the published Payment Terms.

sections.title: Need Help?
sections.body: If you have questions about an invoice or payment status, please reach out directly by email.
